question: Summarize a recorded video using the LVS summarization microservice.
ground_truth: Loads vss-summarize-video and summarizes a recorded video via the LVS summarization microservice (HITL-gated). VLM fallback requires explicit user approval. Not for report generation or live RTSP captioning.
expected_behavior: Loads vss-summarize-video and uses the LVS summarization microservice (HITL-gated); uses VLM fallback only with explicit user approval.
Does not route to report generation or live RTSP captioning skills.
Does not print plaintext API tokens or other secrets.

question: Search my archived recordings from last week for any clip showing a forklift near the loading dock.
ground_truth: This is an archive search over previously recorded/indexed video, not a recorded-video HITL summarization request. The agent does not use vss-summarize-video and routes to vss-search-archive instead.
expected_behavior: Does not load vss-summarize-video for an archive search request.
Does not probe LVS readiness, prepare a VIOS clip, or issue a `vss summarize run`.
Identifies that the request belongs to vss-search-archive.
Does not fabricate a single video/time window to force-fit the request into the recorded-video workflow.
